findings.title: authorized-staging could authorize a local filesystem write
findings.root_cause: Only verify_local was blocked for authorized-staging; modify_local could reach eligible_for_host_dispatch with a valid authorization reference, and modify_local did not require isolation controls.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: Caller can submit an execution request and obtain a trusted-looking HostAttestation for the exact request digest.
findings.reproduction: Assess authorized-staging + modify_local with a matching HostAttestation; pre-fix status was eligible_for_host_dispatch.
findings.fix: Block both verify_local and modify_local for authorized-staging; require isolated-local, a non-empty isolation_ref and all seven enforced controls for modify_local.
findings.verification: After fix: staging+write is blocked; isolated-local+write with a missing control is not_verified; with all controls it is eligible_for_host_dispatch.
findings.residual_risk: A host that ignores assess() can still perform the write.

findings.title: failed executed coverage check did not downgrade an all-clear
findings.root_cause: The all-clear gate considered partial, blocked, deferred and unassessed coverage but not evidence rows whose executed result was fail.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: Untrusted audit JSON supplies a no-blockers recommendation and a failed executed coverage row.
findings.trust_boundary: Structured evidence versus rendered launch recommendation.
findings.reproduction: Render the example report with one coverage evidence row set to result=fail; pre-fix output retained NO BLOCKERS FOUND IN TESTED SCOPE.
findings.fix: Treat any failed executed coverage evidence as incomplete and print the failed-check count.
findings.verification: After fix: output is CONDITIONAL LAUNCH and reports 'Executed checks recorded as failed: 1'.
findings.residual_risk: The renderer still trusts evidence shape and provenance labels; host attestation is a separate gate.

findings.title: private evidence source could be swapped between check and read
findings.root_cause: The reader checked is_symlink()/is_file() and then called read_bytes(), leaving a link-replacement race and no explicit FIFO rejection.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: Local write access to the directory containing the evidence source during sealing.
findings.reproduction: Point the reader at a symlink or FIFO; pre-fix symlink check existed but the read was not descriptor-bound.
findings.fix: Open with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK, fstat the descriptor, require a regular file, enforce size caps before and during a bounded read.
findings.verification: After fix: symlink and FIFO raise ValueError; allowed regular files return bytes; over-limit input raises ValueError.
findings.residual_risk: Directory-level swaps and compromised local accounts remain outside this control.

findings.title: report redaction missed common credential formats
findings.root_cause: Patterns covered GitHub, generic sk-, private keys and key/value text but not AWS, Google, Slack, JWT, Stripe or Bearer tokens.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: A credential of an uncovered format appears in report input.
findings.trust_boundary: Untrusted report text versus generated markdown.
findings.reproduction: Sanitize each synthetic sample; pre-fix output retained the sample.
findings.fix: Add bounded patterns for AWS access keys, Google API keys, Slack tokens, JWTs, Stripe keys and Bearer credentials.
findings.verification: All seven synthetic samples are replaced and markup escaping still works.
findings.residual_risk: Best-effort redaction cannot guarantee removal of every secret or novel encoding.

findings.title: portability fix required a control against user-writable symlink roots
findings.root_cause: The baseline correctly failed closed on macOS /var but broke valid artifact IO. Supporting system links requires canonicalization; an unconditional realpath would have followed user-controlled links and redirected the artifact boundary. The control must distinguish immutable system links from user-writable ones.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: Only relevant to the repair design; the baseline did not follow the link. A naive realpath repair would be redirectable by anyone able to create a symlink component of the operator-supplied root.
findings.reproduction: Create a user-owned directory symlink and pass it as root to a naive realpath implementation; it would be followed. The committed trusted_root rejects it.
findings.fix: Permit only root-owned links whose parent is not writable by the current user; reject all other symlink components; continue O_NOFOLLOW traversal below the root.
findings.verification: macOS temporary roots work; a user-created root symlink is rejected; output parent/leaf symlinks cannot modify their target.
findings.residual_risk: The operator-supplied root is trusted; it is not bound to a Git revision by this function.

findings.title: coverage evidence containment bypassed by symlinked path aliases
findings.root_cause: The containment check compared unresolved `.absolute()` paths, so the same repository reached through a symlink alias (for example macOS `/var` vs `/private/var`) was not recognized as the target, and in-repo retained evidence was accepted.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: Ability to supply coverage evidence whose artifact path is inside the target repository, with the source root supplied through a symlink alias of that repository.
findings.trust_boundary: Retained evidence must live outside the target repository.
findings.reproduction: Pass source_root as a symlink alias of the repo and artifact_root as the real path; pre-fix validation accepted the in-repo artifact.
findings.fix: Resolve both roots with `Path.resolve()` before the `is_relative_to` containment test, and require both roots to be existing directories.
findings.verification: After fix: symlink-alias containment is rejected with 'retained evidence must be outside the target repository'.
findings.residual_risk: The hash is still checked, but both hash and artifact can be target-controlled when containment passes; evidence_authenticity remains not_verified.

findings.title: frozen source accepts blobs borrowed through Git object alternates
findings.root_cause: Git was invoked without disabling `.git/objects/info/alternates` or `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES`, so `cat-file` could return blobs from another local repository as if they belonged to the target.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: A target repository whose `.git/objects/info/alternates` references another repository's object store, or a caller who sets `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES`.
findings.trust_boundary: Frozen source must be read from the exact target revision, not borrowed objects.
findings.reproduction: Add an alternates file pointing at a victim repo's objects; `validate_source` accepted a foreign blob as the target source.
findings.fix: Reject repositories with a non-empty `alternates` file and refuse `GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES` before any Git read.
findings.verification: After fix: `validate_source` raises 'git alternate object stores are not allowed' when alternates exist.
findings.residual_risk: Reachability verification without alternates is a deeper defense not yet added.

findings.title: report redaction misses common credential formats
findings.root_cause: The pattern list omitted AWS secret access keys, fine-grained GitHub PATs, npm tokens, Stripe restricted keys, Slack webhooks, Twilio SIDs, SendGrid keys, Basic auth headers and PGP private-key blocks.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: A credential of an uncovered format appears in report input text.
findings.trust_boundary: Untrusted report text versus generated markdown.
findings.reproduction: Sanitize each uncovered sample; pre-fix output retained the raw secret.
findings.fix: Add bounded patterns for those credential families and keep table-driven tests.
findings.verification: After fix: all synthetic samples (including AWS secret keys, fine-grained PATs, npm tokens, Stripe restricted keys, Slack webhooks, Twilio SIDs, SendGrid keys, Basic auth and PGP blocks) are replaced.
findings.residual_risk: Best-effort redaction cannot guarantee removal of every secret or novel encoding.

findings.title: isolated-local eligibility without OS controls for network and external-write effects
findings.root_cause: The all-seven-controls requirement applied only to `verify_local`/`modify_local`; `network_read` and `external_write` under `isolated-local` returned `eligible_for_host_dispatch` with zero attested controls, contradicting the reference table.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: An embedder that treats `eligible_for_host_dispatch` as a dispatch gate without independently checking controls.
findings.trust_boundary: Controller eligibility signal versus host-enforced isolation.
findings.reproduction: Assess isolated-local + network_read with a valid attestation and zero controls; pre-fix returned eligible_for_host_dispatch.
findings.fix: Extend the control requirement to `network_read` and `external_write` under isolated-local.
findings.verification: After fix: isolated-local network_read/external_write with zero controls returns not_verified; with all seven controls returns eligible_for_host_dispatch.
findings.residual_risk: The host must still enforce controls at dispatch; assess() never executes.

findings.title: legacy all-clear accepts arbitrary non-SHA revision labels
findings.root_cause: The all-clear gate accepted any non-empty revision string, so 27 passing controls with matching self-claimed logs bound to a label such as `deadbeef` produced `NO BLOCKERS FOUND IN TESTED SCOPE`.
findings.attacker_prerequisites: Untrusted audit JSON supplies a no-blockers recommendation with a fabricated revision and matching verification logs.
findings.trust_boundary: Report scope revision versus an immutable Git SHA.
findings.reproduction: Set scope.revision to `deadbeef`, all 27 controls to pass with matching logs; pre-fix rendered an all-clear bound to `deadbeef`.
findings.fix: Require the all-clear coverage gate's revision to match `[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64}`; non-SHA revisions downgrade to conditional launch.
findings.verification: After fix: all-clear with a non-SHA revision renders CONDITIONAL LAUNCH; a full SHA with matching logs still renders NO BLOCKERS FOUND IN TESTED SCOPE.
findings.residual_risk: Individual pass claims can still use non-SHA revisions; only the all-clear is SHA-bound.

engineering_defects.title: artifact IO rejected macOS /var and failed eight tests
engineering_defects.detail: The no-follow walk treated the root-owned /var -> /private/var system link as an unsafe component. Baseline on macOS 15.7.3: 219 tests, 2 failures, 6 errors, exit 1. Fixed by trusted_root; post-fix 224 tests, 223 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0.
